sensors.title: Primary weather and complementary sensors
sensors.description: Fill in one primary weather entity, then any complementary sensors if you have them. Weather stays the priority, and provided sensors override or complete missing values.

data.capteur_etp: Daily ETP (optional, automatic if not provided)
data.capteur_humidite: Local humidity (optional, used first if provided)
data.capteur_retour_arrosage: Watering return (optional, automatic or estimated from zone history)
data.capteur_vent: Local wind (optional, used first if provided)
data.capteur_rosee: Dew / leaf wetness (optional, automatic if not provided)
data.capteur_rayonnement: Measured global solar radiation (optional, W/m² — greatly improves ET0 accuracy)
data.capteur_pression: Measured atmospheric pressure (optional, hPa — refines ET0 accuracy)

set_mode.name: Set mode
set_mode.description: Chooses a mode (Overseeding, Treatment, etc.) and updates the calculations.

set_date_action.name: Record date
set_date_action.description: Sets the real date of the action (DD/MM/YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD). If empty, today is used.

date_action.name: Date
date_action.description: Date in DD/MM/YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD format.

reset_mode.name: Back to normal mode
reset_mode.description: Resets the system to Normal mode.

start_manual_irrigation.name: Manual watering
start_manual_irrigation.description: Starts a manual watering cycle and specifies how much water to apply in mm.

objectif_mm.name: Water to apply
objectif_mm.description: Amount of water to apply in millimeters.

start_auto_irrigation.name: Automatic watering
start_auto_irrigation.description: Runs each zone in sequence with the configured flow rate. If the water amount is empty, it uses the calculated value automatically.

objectif_mm.name: Water to apply (optional)
objectif_mm.description: Water amount in mm. If omitted, uses the objective calculated by the current mode.

plan_arrosage_entity.name: Watering plan entity (optional)
plan_arrosage_entity.description: Sensor entity for the calculated plan to launch manually.

source.name: Execution source (optional)
source.description: auto_irrigation for automatic runs, manual for a hand-triggered launch.

start_application_irrigation.name: Water now
start_application_irrigation.description: Triggers a controlled post-application watering without directly driving the zones.

declare_intervention.name: Declare an intervention
declare_intervention.description: Logs a real intervention. Product settings live in "Register a product"; here you only choose the already registered product, the action date, the zone, and an optional note. If no explicit product is provided, the integration can use the current UI selection or return a clear error.

date_action.name: Action date (optional)
date_action.description: Business date in DD/MM/YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD format. If empty, today is used.

produit_id.name: Product ID (optional)
produit_id.description: Identifier of a product already saved in the local database.

produit.name: Product (optional)
produit.description: Name of the product or reference applied.

remove_last_application.name: Remove last application
remove_last_application.description: Removes the last recorded application from local history.

register_product.name: Register a product
register_product.description: Adds or updates a custom product in the local database. The category is chosen from a list, the dose can be entered per m², and the allowed application months can also be specified. All product settings are defined here and reused later by declare_intervention.

type.name: Product category
type.description: Choose the product category from the list.

dose_conseillee.name: Recommended dose per m² (optional)
dose_conseillee.description: Example: 1.2 ml / m². The text is kept as entered.

reapplication_after_days.name: Reapply in X days (optional)
reapplication_after_days.description: Recommended delay before using it again.

delai_avant_tonte_jours.name: Delay before mowing (optional)
delai_avant_tonte_jours.description: Time to wait before the next mow.

phase_compatible.name: Compatible phases (optional)
phase_compatible.description: Multiple choices allowed. Example: Overseeding, Growth, Maintenance.

application_months.name: Allowed application months (optional)
application_months.description: List the allowed months. Example: 3,4,5,9,10 or March to May + September to October.

application_requires_watering_after.name: Watering after application required (optional)
application_requires_watering_after.description: Indicates whether a technical watering should follow.

application_post_watering_mm.name: Post-application watering (mm, optional)
application_post_watering_mm.description: Technical amount of water to apply after the application.

application_irrigation_delay_minutes.name: Delay before watering (min, optional)
application_irrigation_delay_minutes.description: Waiting time before authorizing post-application watering.

application_label_notes.name: Label notes (optional)
application_label_notes.description: Informational notes related to the product label.

usage_mode.name: Usage mode
usage_mode.description: Context in which the product is used.

max_applications_per_year.name: Max applications per year
max_applications_per_year.description: Maximum number of applications allowed per year.

temperature_min.name: Minimum temperature (°C)
temperature_min.description: Below this, the product is not recommended.

temperature_max.name: Maximum temperature (°C)
temperature_max.description: Above this, the product is not recommended.

remove_product.name: Remove a product
remove_product.description: Removes a product from the local database.

product_id.name: Product ID
product_id.description: Identifier of the product to delete.

declare_mowing.name: Declare mowing
declare_mowing.description: Logs a mowing event in the history of the targeted lawn. Choose the lawn's mowing authorization entity.

entity_id.name: Mowing entity
entity_id.description: Choose the lawn binary_sensor.*_tonte_autorisee entity. Main lawn example: binary_sensor.gazon_intelligent_tonte_autorisee. Potager example: binary_sensor.gazon_intelligent_gazon_potager_tonte_autorisee.

date_action.name: Mowing date (optional)
date_action.description: Date in DD/MM/YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD format. If empty, today is used.

hauteur_coupe_mm.name: Cutting height (mm)
hauteur_coupe_mm.description: Cutting height used for this mow, in millimetres.

declare_watering.name: Declare watering
declare_watering.description: Logs a watering event in the history.

date_action.name: Watering date (optional)
date_action.description: Date in DD/MM/YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD format. If empty, today is used.

objectif_mm.name: Applied amount (optional)
objectif_mm.description: Amount of water applied in mm.

recalibrate_reserve.name: Recalibrate soil reserve
recalibrate_reserve.description: Sets the soil water reserve to a known value. The value stays frozen until the next day: rain, watering and evapotranspiration are no longer counted for today. Best called in the evening, outside a rain event.

reserve_mm.name: Soil reserve (mm)
reserve_mm.description: Measured or estimated soil water reserve, in millimetres.

stop_irrigation.name: Stop watering
stop_irrigation.description: Immediately stops the running watering cycle: closes the open valve, records the water already applied and releases the cycle.

raison.name: Reason
raison.description: Why it was stopped, kept in the action log.
